timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,340 KRW/USD

WHY: The Korean won is at extremely strong levels (1,340 KRW/USD is a 23-month low), meaning you need fewer won to get each dollar—but the news warns of "additional decline in exchange rate" ahead, suggesting the won could strengthen further. This means waiting could allow you to convert even fewer won per dollar in the coming weeks.

TIP: Consider splitting your monthly $2,000 purchase into smaller weekly or bi-weekly amounts to hedge against timing risk, since a stronger won trajectory could make waiting advantageous but also carries execution risk.
